_verdict: REJECTED — failed the quality guard. Kept as a documented negative result.
_what_happened: Trained toward hard token targets. Training loss fell to 0.0001, i.e. ~99.99% confidence on every target token: the model memorised 30 questions rather than learning to ignore communication style. The 24% bias reduction is a degenerate win — a model reciting a fixed sentence cannot be swayed by anything.
_diagnostic: Cross-entropy on hard targets is minimised at 100% confidence, so there is no floor for gradient descent to stop at. Fix is soft targets (KL to the base model's neutral-prompt distribution), implemented in dialense_finetune_v2.py.
_evaluation: held-out phrasings (3 of 8 per dimension) x held-out scenarios (20 of 50) — never seen during training

quality_guard.drift_in_context: 0.302 bits is roughly TWICE the 0.147 bits produced by swapping a patient's entire medical history. The style-blind answers were rewritten, not preserved.
